name: Narragansett Boat Club Youth Rowing Summer Camp
description_short: A week-long rowing camp on the Seekonk River for beginner and intermediate youth rowers. It runs 9am–11am each weekday and is coached by varsity coaches, with current and former junior rowers on staff.
swim_waterfront_notes: Rowing takes place on the water on the Seekonk River. The page does not state any swim test or swimming ability requirement.
